Sandbox_PhunServer2Commands_PlayersComma: Allow players to see who is online by typing /players into chat
Sandbox_PhunServer2Commands_PlayersOffli: When using /players, also list players who have been online in the past 24 hours
Sandbox_PhunServer2Commands_GetHours_too: Allow players to see their hours survived with /hours. Admins and moderators can query another online player with /hours username.
Sandbox_PhunServer2Commands_SetHours_too: Allow admins and moderators to set a player's hours survived with /sethours username hours. The target player must be online.
